prompt: A 59-year-old man is assessed on admission with PCR-confirmed COVID-19. His qualifying comorbidities are diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease. Before treatment, his respiratory rate is exactly 29/min, room-air oxygen saturation is exactly 91%, and Glasgow Coma Scale score is 15. Serum urea is exactly 14.0 mmol/L and C-reactive protein is exactly 100 mg/L. Using the 4C Mortality Score, what is his total score and risk category?

rubric_items.text: States the 4C Mortality Score is 11 out of 21 (exact integer match required).
States the interpretation is high risk (score 9–14; exact or equivalent wording acceptable).
